description.value: 17℃ Bubble Tea & Dessert Café is a Vancouver dessert spot on the Kingsway corridor specializing in artisanal bubble teas and signature shaved-ice 'Ice Pot' creations made with 100% Canadian milk and carefully selected fresh fruit. In operation since 2017, it has expanded into a franchise with this Kingsway location as headquarters. Touring cyclists passing through East Vancouver will find a varied sweet-drink-and-dessert menu with a loyalty rewards program.
